Description:
I have a singer and i was stupid enough that unlike rest of the band (that i asked to animate while ago) i can handle the mic myself.... yet after attempts i realized that my drawing skills are absolutly worthless even despite all the practice i am having while making this game. So i would be really grateful if someone would help me with it.
So the main thing i need is to place character's hands on mic (or rather mic stand?) so the pose will not look so terrible during the performance.
Additionnaly, if you are able to animate stuff, you can do:
1) Slight movements of head or torso on stepping animation. Or just anything to make her look alive, but not too much (so the animation can be shown for long).
2) Something for screaming? Idk.
(Just keep mouth hidden behind mic so it does not need to have separate animation set)
3) Maybe a trick like spinning the mic, throwing it in air, or something else for heavy riff drops. Just keep it all seperate from main one so i can switch it on when i need it.
Honestly just anything that will make her look cool and more of a rock star will do.
The character file is attached, the mic comes from here:
https://tm.lucky-duet.com/viewtopic.php?f=15&t=7048
You can change it if you find something more fitting, but from all mics i saw that was the best one.
